title: krokia podocarpoides
intro: Krokia podocarpoides, commonly known as the East Himalayan Krokia, is a plant species found in the Himalayan region. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Krokia podocarpoides include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing fever, pain, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties.
